data.long_meaning: Aadhil (عادل) is a transliteration of the Arabic ʿādil, 'just, fair, equitable', the active participle of ʿadala, 'to act justly'. It is a well-attested name from the root ʿ-d-l, the root of ʿadl, 'justice'.

faq.q: Is Aadhil a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aadhil is used as a male name.

faq.q: How is Aadhil written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aadhil is written عادل in Arabic and عادل in Urdu, and आदिल in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aadhil?
faq.a: The root of Aadhil is ع-د-ل (ʿ-d-l).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aadhil?
faq.a: Arabic ʿādil, active participle of ʿadala, 'to act justly'.

faq.q: Does Aadhil appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic personal name; ʿādil is Arabic vocabulary from the root ʿ-d-l.

faq.q: Is Aadhil the same as Aadil?
faq.a: Yes. Aadhil and Aadil are transliterations of the same Arabic ʿādil (عادل), meaning 'just, fair'.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aadhil?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aadhil total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.a: Aadhil appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Adil, Aadil.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aadhil?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aadhil include Aadil, Aadila.
